verses.original: Ἔστιν δὲ πίστις ἐλπιζομένων ὑπόστασις πραγμάτων ἔλεγχος οὐ βλεπομένων
verses.transliteration: Estin de pistis elpizomenōn hypostasis pragmatōn elenchos ou blepomenōn
verses.literal: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see
verses.literalPt: ORA, a fé é o firme fundamento das coisas que se esperam, e a prova das coisas que se não vêem.

verses.original: ἐν ταύτῃ γὰρ ἐμαρτυρήθησαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι
verses.transliteration: en tautē gar emartyrēthēsan hoi presbyteroi
verses.literal: This is why the ancients were commended
verses.literalPt: Porque por ela os antigos alcançaram testemunho.

verses.original: Πίστει νοοῦμεν κατηρτίσθαι τοὺς αἰῶνας ῥήματι Θεοῦ εἰς τὸ μὴ ἐκ φαινομένων τὸ βλεπόμενον γεγονέναι
verses.transliteration: Pistei nooumen katērtisthai tous aiōnas rhēmati Theou eis to mē ek phainomenōn to blepomenon gegonenai
verses.literal: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command . . . so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible
verses.literalPt: Pela fé entendemos que os mundos pela palavra de Deus foram criados; de maneira que aquilo que se vê não foi feito do que é aparente.

verses.original: Πίστει πλείονα θυσίαν Ἅβελ παρὰ Κάϊν προσήνεγκεν τῷ Θεῷ δι’ ἧς ἐμαρτυρήθη εἶναι δίκαιος μαρτυροῦντος ἐπὶ τοῖς δώροις αὐτοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ δι’ αὐτῆς ἀποθανὼν ἔτι λαλεῖ
verses.transliteration: Pistei pleiona thysian Habel para Kain prosēnenken tō Theō di’ hēs emartyrēthē einai dikaios martyrountos epi tois dōrois autou tou Theou kai di’ autēs apothanōn eti lalei
verses.literal: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts And by faith he still speaks even though he is dead
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Abel ofereceu a Deus maior sacrifício do que Caim, pelo qual alcançou testemunho de que era justo, dando Deus testemunho dos seus dons, e por ela, depois de morto, ainda fala.

verses.original: Πίστει Ἑνὼχ μετετέθη τοῦ μὴ ἰδεῖν θάνατον καὶ οὐχ ηὑρίσκετο διότι μετέθηκεν αὐτὸν ὁ Θεός πρὸ γὰρ τῆς μεταθέσεως μεμαρτύρηται εὐαρεστηκέναι τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Pistei Henōch metetethē tou mē idein thanaton kai ouch hēurisketo dioti metethēken auton ho Theos pro gar tēs metatheseōs memartyrētai euarestēkenai tō Theō
verses.literal: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death He could not be found because God had taken him away . . . For before he was taken he was commended as one who pleased God
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Enoque foi trasladado para não ver a morte, e não foi achado, porque Deus o trasladara; visto como antes da sua trasladação alcançou testemunho de que agradara a Deus.

verses.original: χωρὶς δὲ πίστεως ἀδύνατον εὐαρεστῆσαι πιστεῦσαι γὰρ δεῖ τὸν προσερχόμενον τῷ Θεῷ ὅτι ἔστιν καὶ τοῖς ἐκζητοῦσιν αὐτὸν μισθαποδότης γίνεται
verses.transliteration: chōris de pisteōs adynaton euarestēsai pisteusai gar dei ton proserchomenon tō Theō hoti estin kai tois ekzētousin auton misthapodotēs ginetai
verses.literal: And without faith it is impossible to please God For anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him
verses.literalPt: Ora, sem fé é impossível agradar-lhe; porque é necessário que aquele que se aproxima de Deus creia que ele existe, e que é galardoador dos que o buscam.

verses.original: Πίστει χρηματισθεὶς Νῶε περὶ τῶν μηδέπω βλεπομένων εὐλαβηθεὶς κατεσκεύασεν κιβωτὸν εἰς σωτηρίαν τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ δι’ ἧς κατέκρινεν τὸν κόσμον καὶ τῆς κατὰ πίστιν δικαιοσύνης ἐγένετο κληρονόμος
verses.transliteration: Pistei chrēmatistheis Nōe peri tōn mēdepō blepomenōn eulabētheis kateskeuasen kibōton eis sōtērian tou oikou autou di’ hēs katekrinen ton kosmon kai tēs kata pistin dikaiosynēs egeneto klēronomos
verses.literal: By faith Noah when warned about things not yet seen in godly fear built an ark to save his family By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Noé, divinamente avisado das coisas que ainda não se viam, temeu e, para salvação da sua família, preparou a arca, pela qual condenou o mundo, e foi feito herdeiro da justiça que é segundo a fé.

verses.original: Πίστει καλούμενος Ἀβραὰμ ὑπήκουσεν ἐξελθεῖν εἰς τόπον ὃν ἤμελλεν λαμβάνειν εἰς κληρονομίαν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν μὴ ἐπιστάμενος ποῦ ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: Pistei kaloumenos Abraam hypēkousen exelthein eis topon hon ēmellen lambanein eis klēronomian kai exēlthen mē epistamenos pou erchetai
verses.literal: By faith Abraham when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance obeyed and went without knowing where he was going
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Abraão, sendo chamado, obedeceu, indo para um lugar que havia de receber por herança; e saiu, sem saber para onde ia.

verses.original: Πίστει παρῴκησεν εἰς γῆν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ὡς ἀλλοτρίαν ἐν σκηναῖς κατοικήσας μετὰ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ τῶν συνκληρονόμων τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῆς αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Pistei parōkēsen eis gēn tēs epangelias hōs allotrian en skēnais katoikēsas meta Isaak kai Iakōb tōn synklēronomōn tēs epangelias tēs autēs
verses.literal: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country He lived in tents as did Isaac and Jacob who were heirs with him of the same promise
verses.literalPt: Pela fé habitou na terra da promessa, como em terra alheia, morando em cabanas com Isaque e Jacó, herdeiros com ele da mesma promessa.

verses.original: ἐξεδέχετο γὰρ τὴν τοὺς θεμελίους ἔχουσαν πόλιν ἧς τεχνίτης καὶ δημιουργὸς ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: exedecheto gar tēn tous themelious echousan polin hēs technitēs kai dēmiourgos ho Theos
verses.literal: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations whose architect and builder is God
verses.literalPt: Porque esperava a cidade que tem fundamentos, da qual o artífice e construtor é Deus.

verses.original: Πίστει καὶ αὐτῇ Σάρρᾳ στεῖρα δύναμιν εἰς καταβολὴν σπέρματος ἔλαβεν καὶ παρὰ καιρὸν ἡλικίας ἐπεὶ πιστὸν ἡγήσατο τὸν ἐπαγγειλάμενον
verses.transliteration: Pistei kai autē Sarra steira dynamin eis katabolēn spermatos elaben kai para kairon hēlikias epei piston hēgēsato ton epangeilamenon
verses.literal: By faith Sarah even though she was barren and beyond the proper age was enabled . . . to conceive a child because she considered Him faithful who had promised
verses.literalPt: Pela fé também a mesma Sara recebeu a virtude de conceber, e deu à luz já fora da idade; porquanto teve por fiel aquele que lho tinha prometido.

verses.original: διὸ καὶ ἀφ’ ἑνὸς ἐγεννήθησαν καὶ ταῦτα νενεκρωμένου καθὼς τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει καὶ ὡς ἡ ἄμμος ἡ παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τῆς θαλάσσης ἡ ἀναρίθμητος
verses.transliteration: dio kai aph’ henos egennēthēsan kai tauta nenekrōmenou kathōs ta astra tou ouranou tō plēthei kai hōs hē ammos hē para to cheilos tēs thalassēs hē anarithmētos
verses.literal: And so from one man and he as good as dead came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Por isso também de um, e esse já amortecido, descenderam tantos, em multidão, como as estrelas do céu, e como a areia inumerável que está na praia do mar.

verses.original: Κατὰ πίστιν ἀπέθανον οὗτοι πάντες μὴ λαμβάνω τὰς ἐπαγγελίας ἀλλὰ πόρρωθεν αὐτὰς ἰδόντες καὶ ἀσπασάμενοι καὶ ὁμολογήσαντες ὅτι ξένοι καὶ παρεπίδημοί εἰσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: Kata pistin apethanon houtoi pantes mē lambanō tas epangelias alla porrōthen autas idontes kai aspasamenoi kai homologēsantes hoti xenoi kai parepidēmoi eisin epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: All these people died in faith without having received the things they were promised However they saw them and welcomed them from afar And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth
verses.literalPt: Todos estes morreram na fé, sem terem recebido as promessas; mas vendo-as de longe, e crendo-as e abraçando-as, confessaram que eram estrangeiros e peregrinos na terra.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ τοιαῦτα λέγοντες ἐμφανίζουσιν ὅτι πατρίδα ἐπιζητοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: hoi gar toiauta legontes emphanizousin hoti patrida epizētousin
verses.literal: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own
verses.literalPt: Porque, os que isto dizem, claramente mostram que buscam uma pátria.

verses.original: καὶ εἰ μὲν ἐκείνης ἐμνημόνευον ἀφ’ ἧς ἐξέβησαν εἶχον ἂν καιρὸν ἀνακάμψαι
verses.transliteration: kai ei men ekeinēs emnēmoneuon aph’ hēs exebēsan eichon an kairon anakampsai
verses.literal: If they had been thinking of the country they had left they would have had opportunity to return
verses.literalPt: E se, na verdade, se lembrassem daquela de onde haviam saído, teriam oportunidade de tornar.

verses.original: νῦν δὲ κρείττονος ὀρέγονται τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ἐπουρανίου διὸ οὐκ ἐπαισχύνεται αὐτοὺς ὁ Θεὸς Θεὸς ἐπικαλεῖσθαι αὐτῶν ἡτοίμασεν γὰρ αὐτοῖς πόλιν
verses.transliteration: nyn de kreittonos oregontai tout’ estin epouraniou dio ouk epaischynetai autous ho Theos Theos epikaleisthai autōn hētoimasen gar autois polin
verses.literal: Instead . . . they were longing for a better country - a heavenly one Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God for He has prepared a city for them
verses.literalPt: Mas agora desejam uma melhor, isto é, a celestial. Por isso também Deus não se envergonha deles, de se chamar seu Deus, porque já lhes preparou uma cidade.

verses.original: Πίστει προσενήνοχεν Ἀβραὰμ τὸν Ἰσαὰκ πειραζόμενος καὶ τὸν μονογενῆ προσέφερεν ὁ τὰς ἐπαγγελίας ἀναδεξάμενος
verses.transliteration: Pistei prosenēnochen Abraam ton Isaak peirazomenos kai ton monogenē prosepheren ho tas epangelias anadexamenos
verses.literal: By faith Abraham when he was tested offered up Isaac on the altar He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son
verses.literalPt: Pela fé ofereceu Abraão a Isaque, quando foi provado; sim, aquele que recebera as promessas ofereceu o seu unigênito.

verses.original: πρὸς ὃν ἐλαλήθη ὅτι Ἐν Ἰσαὰκ κληθήσεταί σοι σπέρμα
verses.transliteration: pros hon elalēthē hoti En Isaak klēthēsetai soi sperma
verses.literal: even though God had said to him Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned
verses.literalPt: Sendo-lhe dito: Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência, considerou que Deus era poderoso para até dentre os mortos o ressuscitar;

verses.original: λογισάμενος ὅτι καὶ ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐγείρειν δυνατὸς ὁ Θεός ὅθεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐν παραβολῇ ἐκομίσατο
verses.transliteration: logisamenos hoti kai ek nekrōn egeirein dynatos ho Theos hothen auton kai en parabolē ekomisato
verses.literal: Abraham reasoned that God could raise - the dead and in a sense he did receive Isaac back from death
verses.literalPt: E daí também em figura ele o recobrou.

verses.original: Πίστει καὶ περὶ μελλόντων εὐλόγησεν Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακὼβ καὶ τὸν Ἠσαῦ
verses.transliteration: Pistei kai peri mellontōn eulogēsen Isaak ton Iakōb kai ton Ēsau
verses.literal: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Isaque abençoou Jacó e Esaú, no tocante às coisas futuras.

verses.original: Πίστει Ἰακὼβ ἀποθνῄσκων ἕκαστον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰωσὴφ εὐλόγησεν καὶ προσεκύνησεν ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς ῥάβδου αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Pistei Iakōb apothnēskōn hekaston tōn huiōn Iōsēph eulogēsen kai prosekynēsen epi to akron tēs rhabdou autou
verses.literal: By faith Jacob when he was dying blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Jacó, próximo da morte, abençoou cada um dos filhos de José, e adorou encostado à ponta do seu bordão.

verses.original: Πίστει Ἰωσὴφ τελευτῶν περὶ τῆς ἐξόδου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐμνημόνευσεν καὶ περὶ τῶν ὀστέων αὐτοῦ ἐνετείλατο
verses.transliteration: Pistei Iōsēph teleutōn peri tēs exodou tōn huiōn Israēl emnēmoneusen kai peri tōn osteōn autou eneteilato
verses.literal: By faith Joseph when his end was near spoke about . . . the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones
verses.literalPt: Pela fé José, próximo da morte, fez menção da saída dos filhos de Israel, e deu ordem acerca de seus ossos.

verses.original: Πίστει Μωϋσῆς γεννηθεὶς ἐκρύβη τρίμηνον ὑπὸ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ διότι εἶδον ἀστεῖον τὸ παιδίον καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸ διάταγμα τοῦ βασιλέως
verses.transliteration: Pistei Mōusēs gennētheis ekrybē trimēnon hypo tōn paterōn autou dioti eidon asteion to paidion kai ouk ephobēthēsan to diatagma tou basileōs
verses.literal: By faith - Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth because they saw that he was a beautiful child and they were unafraid of the king’s edict
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Moisés, já nascido, foi escondido três meses por seus pais, porque viram que era um menino formoso; e não temeram o mandamento do rei.

verses.original: Πίστει Μωϋσῆς μέγας γενόμενος ἠρνήσατο λέγεσθαι υἱὸς θυγατρὸς Φαραώ
verses.transliteration: Pistei Mōusēs megas genomenos ērnēsato legesthai huios thygatros Pharaō
verses.literal: By faith Moses when he was grown refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Moisés, sendo já grande, recusou ser chamado filho da filha de Faraó,

verses.original: μᾶλλον ἑλόμενος συνκακουχεῖσθαι τῷ λαῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἢ πρόσκαιρον ἔχειν ἁμαρτίας ἀπόλαυσιν
verses.transliteration: mallon helomenos synkakoucheisthai tō laō tou Theou ē proskairon echein hamartias apolausin
verses.literal: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin
verses.literalPt: Escolhendo antes ser maltratado com o povo de Deus, do que por um pouco de tempo ter o gozo do pecado;

verses.original: μείζονα πλοῦτον ἡγησάμενος τῶν Αἰγύπτου θησαυρῶν τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἀπέβλεπεν γὰρ εἰς τὴν μισθαποδοσίαν
verses.transliteration: meizona plouton hēgēsamenos tōn Aigyptou thēsaurōn ton oneidismon tou Christou apeblepen gar eis tēn misthapodosian
verses.literal: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt for he was looking ahead to his reward
verses.literalPt: Tendo por maiores riquezas o vitupério de Cristo do que os tesouros do Egito; porque tinha em vista a recompensa.

verses.original: Πίστει κατέλιπεν Αἴγυπτον μὴ φοβηθεὶς τὸν θυμὸν τοῦ βασιλέως τὸν γὰρ ἀόρατον ὡς ὁρῶν ἐκαρτέρησεν
verses.transliteration: Pistei katelipen Aigypton mē phobētheis ton thymon tou basileōs ton gar aoraton hōs horōn ekarterēsen
verses.literal: By faith Moses left Egypt not fearing the king’s anger he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible
verses.literalPt: Pela fé deixou o Egito, não temendo a ira do rei; porque ficou firme, como vendo o invisível.

verses.original: Πίστει πεποίηκεν τὸ πάσχα καὶ τὴν πρόσχυσιν τοῦ αἵματος ἵνα μὴ ὁ ὀλοθρεύων τὰ πρωτότοκα θίγῃ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Pistei pepoiēken to pascha kai tēn proschysin tou haimatos hina mē ho olothreuōn ta prōtotoka thigē autōn
verses.literal: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn
verses.literalPt: Pela fé celebrou a páscoa e a aspersão do sangue, para que o destruidor dos primogênitos lhes não tocasse.

verses.original: Πίστει διέβησαν τὴν Ἐρυθρὰν Θάλασσαν ὡς διὰ ξηρᾶς γῆς ἧς πεῖραν λαβόντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι κατεπόθησαν
verses.transliteration: Pistei diebēsan tēn Erythran Thalassan hōs dia xēras gēs hēs peiran labontes hoi Aigyptioi katepothēsan
verses.literal: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land but when the Egyptians tried to follow they were drowned
verses.literalPt: Pela fé passaram o Mar Vermelho, como por terra seca; o que intentando os egípcios, se afogaram.

verses.original: Πίστει τὰ τείχη Ἰεριχὼ ἔπεσαν κυκλωθέντα ἐπὶ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: Pistei ta teichē Ierichō epesan kyklōthenta epi hepta hēmeras
verses.literal: By faith the walls of Jericho fell after the people had marched around them for seven days
verses.literalPt: Pela fé caíram os muros de Jericó, sendo rodeados durante sete dias.

verses.original: Πίστει Ῥαὰβ ἡ πόρνη οὐ συναπώλετο τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν δεξαμένη τοὺς κατασκόπους μετ’ εἰρήνης
verses.transliteration: Pistei Rhaab hē pornē ou synapōleto tois apeithēsasin dexamenē tous kataskopous met’ eirēnēs
verses.literal: By faith the prostitute Rahab because she welcomed the spies in peace did not perish with those who were disobedient
verses.literalPt: Pela fé Raabe, a meretriz, não pereceu com os incrédulos, acolhendo em paz os espias.

verses.original: Καὶ τί ἔτι λέγω ἐπιλείψει με γὰρ διηγούμενον ὁ χρόνος περὶ Γεδεών Βαράκ Σαμψών Ἰεφθάε Δαυίδ τε καὶ Σαμουὴλ καὶ τῶν προφητῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai ti eti legō epileipsei me gar diēgoumenon ho chronos peri Gedeōn Barak Sampsōn Iephthae Dauid te kai Samouēl kai tōn prophētōn
verses.literal: And what more shall I say - Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon Barak Samson Jephthah David Samuel and the prophets
verses.literalPt: E que mais direi? Faltar-me-ia o tempo contando de Gideão, e de Baraque, e de Sansão, e de Jefté, e de Davi, e de Samuel e dos profetas,

verses.original: οἳ διὰ πίστεως κατηγωνίσαντο βασιλείας εἰργάσαντο δικαιοσύνην ἐπέτυχον ἐπαγγελιῶν ἔφραξαν στόματα λεόντων
verses.transliteration: hoi dia pisteōs katēgōnisanto basileias eirgasanto dikaiosynēn epetychon epangeliōn ephraxan stomata leontōn
verses.literal: who through faith conquered kingdoms administered justice and gained what was promised who shut the mouths of lions
verses.literalPt: Os quais pela fé venceram reinos, praticaram a justiça, alcançaram promessas, fecharam as bocas dos leões,

verses.original: ἔσβεσαν δύναμιν πυρός ἔφυγον στόματα μαχαίρης ἐδυναμώθησαν ἀπὸ ἀσθενείας ἐγενήθησαν ἰσχυροὶ ἐν πολέμῳ παρεμβολὰς ἔκλιναν ἀλλοτρίων
verses.transliteration: esbesan dynamin pyros ephygon stomata machairēs edynamōthēsan apo astheneias egenēthēsan ischyroi en polemō parembolas eklinan allotriōn
verses.literal: quenched the raging fire and escaped the edge of the sword who gained strength from weakness became mighty in battle and put foreign armies to flight
verses.literalPt: Apagaram a força do fogo, escaparam do fio da espada, da fraqueza tiraram forças, na batalha se esforçaram, puseram em fuga os exércitos dos estranhos.

verses.original: Ἔλαβον γυναῖκες ἐξ ἀναστάσεως τοὺς νεκροὺς αὐτῶν ἄλλοι δὲ ἐτυμπανίσθησαν οὐ προσδεξάμενοι τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν ἵνα κρείττονος ἀναστάσεως τύχωσιν
verses.transliteration: Elabon gynaikes ex anastaseōs tous nekrous autōn alloi de etympanisthēsan ou prosdexamenoi tēn apolytrōsin hina kreittonos anastaseōs tychōsin
verses.literal: Women received back their dead raised to life again Others were tortured and refused their release so that they might gain a better resurrection
verses.literalPt: As mulheres receberam pela ressurreição os seus mortos; uns foram torturados, não aceitando o seu livramento, para alcançarem uma melhor ressurreição;

verses.original: ἕτεροι δὲ ἐμπαιγμῶν καὶ μαστίγων πεῖραν ἔλαβον ἔτι δὲ δεσμῶν καὶ φυλακῆς
verses.transliteration: heteroi de empaigmōn kai mastigōn peiran elabon eti de desmōn kai phylakēs
verses.literal: Still others endured . . . mocking and flogging and even chains and imprisonment
verses.literalPt: E outros experimentaram escárnios e açoites, e até cadeias e prisões.

verses.original: Ἐλιθάσθησαν ἐπρίσθησαν ἐν φόνῳ μαχαίρης ἀπέθανον περιῆλθον ἐν μηλωταῖς ἐν αἰγείοις δέρμασιν ὑστερούμενοι θλιβόμενοι κακουχούμενοι
verses.transliteration: Elithasthēsan epristhēsan en phonō machairēs apethanon periēlthon en mēlōtais en aigeiois dermasin hysteroumenoi thlibomenoi kakouchoumenoi
verses.literal: They were stoned they were sawed in two they were put to death by the sword They went around in sheepskins and goatskins . . . destitute oppressed and mistreated
verses.literalPt: Foram apedrejados, serrados, tentados, mortos ao fio da espada; andaram vestidos de peles de ovelhas e de cabras, desamparados, aflitos e maltratados

verses.original: ὧν οὐκ ἦν ἄξιος ὁ κόσμος ἐπὶ ἐρημίαις πλανώμενοι καὶ ὄρεσιν καὶ σπηλαίοις καὶ ταῖς ὀπαῖς τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: hōn ouk ēn axios ho kosmos epi erēmiais planōmenoi kai oresin kai spēlaiois kai tais opais tēs gēs
verses.literal: The world was not worthy of them They wandered in deserts and mountains and hid in caves and holes in the ground
verses.literalPt: (Dos quais o mundo não era digno), errantes pelos desertos, e montes, e pelas covas e cavernas da terra.

verses.original: Καὶ οὗτοι πάντες μαρτυρηθέντες διὰ τῆς πίστεως οὐκ ἐκομίσαντο τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai houtoi pantes martyrēthentes dia tēs pisteōs ouk ekomisanto tēn epangelian
verses.literal: These were all commended for their faith yet they did not receive what was promised
verses.literalPt: E todos estes, tendo tido testemunho pela fé, não alcançaram a promessa,

verses.original: τοῦ Θεοῦ περὶ ἡμῶν κρεῖττόν τι προβλεψαμένου ἵνα μὴ χωρὶς ἡμῶν τελειωθῶσιν
verses.transliteration: tou Theou peri hēmōn kreitton ti problepsamenou hina mē chōris hēmōn teleiōthōsin
verses.literal: God had planned something better for us so that together with us they would be made perfect
verses.literalPt: Provendo Deus alguma coisa melhor a nosso respeito, para que eles sem nós não fossem aperfeiçoados.
